observations: 2026-08-11: the Cowboys' first unofficial 2026 depth chart lists the RB order as Javonte Williams (RB1), Jaydon Blue (RB2), Phil Mafah, Malik Davis — no 'OR' designations at RB (A to Z Sports, 08-11).

The game has slowed down a lot to me' (Sporting Tribune 08-05; dallascowboys.com 08-05).

Counter-signal: at Tuesday's joint practice vs. the Rams (best-recoverable date 2026-08-11, inferred from 'Tuesday' + 08-12 publication, not stated verbatim), Blue 'coughed up a fumble early in team drills' and 'saw his workload dwindle for the rest of the day' (Landry Hat; NBC DFW 08-12). Former Cowboy Isaiah Stanback: fumbles 'held him back' at Texas and it 'showed his ugly head again'. College context per Landry Hat: 7 fumbles over his final two Texas seasons, 5 in 2024.
inferences: Directional mechanism (pre-baseline, preserved as inference): upward role pressure from the provisional RB2 listing and camp momentum, opposed by ball-security risk that has already produced an observed same-day workload reduction — trust in the RB2 hold remains genuinely uncertain (TRUST ?).
In 2025 it was Davis, not Blue, who emerged as the backup when injuries hit; the 2026 chart ordering reverses that and is provisional.
